name: tl;dv
summary: AI meeting recorder and note taker with a free plan; says customer content is not used to train AI models.

trainingDefault.quote: to train, fine-tune, or improve foundation models, large language models

subprocessorTraining.quote: or such providers to train or improve their general-purpose AI models

dpa.quote: tl;dv is GDPR-compliant for all users.

adminEnforcement.quote: Single Sign-On (SSO) is available to all users

caveats.text: Free-plan recordings are kept for 3 months; paid plans until account deletion.
tl;dv works with Anthropic and says it anonymises metadata shared with it.

evidence.quote: We are anonymizing any metadata we share with Anthropic.
